items.title: 德权威机构大幅上调2026年德国经济增长预期
items.summary: 中新社柏林11月11日电 (记者 马秀秀)德国经济专家委员会11日发布的报告预计，2026年德国经济将增长1.3%。若这一预测实现，德国经济将迎来自2022年以来首次较为明显的增长。
items.titleEn: German authorities significantly updated forecasts for 2026
items.summaryEn: A report by the German Economic Experts' Committee on 11 November (Reporter Maashow) predicts that the German economy will grow by 1.3% in 2026. If this forecast is realized, Germany's economy will experience significant growth for the first time since 2022.

items.title: 俄美乌三方会谈结束 俄乌就大规模换俘达成一致
items.summary: 中新社莫斯科11月11日电 俄罗斯、美国、乌克兰三方会谈代表11日在阿拉伯联合酋长国首都阿布扎比结束会谈。俄罗斯总统助理、俄方代表团团长梅金斯基在会谈结束后对媒体表示，欧洲安全体系是本次会谈的核心议题，各方在某些方面达成了共识。俄乌就新一轮大规模换俘达成一致。
items.titleEn: Three-party talks ended with a large-scale exchange of prisoners
items.summaryEn: The representatives of Russia, the United States, and Ukraine concluded their three-party talks on November 11 in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates. At the end of the meeting, Assistant to the President of Russia, Head of the Russian Delegation, Mikhail Mikhail Mikheil Meckinsky, told the media that the European security system was the central topic of the meeting and that the parties had reached consensus on some aspects. OU has agreed to a new round of large-scale prisoner exchanges.

items.title: 纪念孙中山诞辰160周年图片展在菲律宾马尼拉开幕

items.titleEn: Photo exhibition to mark the 160th anniversary of Sun Yat-sen's birth opens in Manila, Philippines
items.summaryEn: On 11 November, a photo exhibition, lecture and film screening event to commemorate the 160th anniversary of the birth of Mr. Sun Zhao San opened in Manila, Philippines. The Chinese Embassy in the Philippines representative Liu Xiaobo, the Hon'ble Consul-General Wang Liu, the Chairman of the General Council of the Fifa Federation, Liu Feng, and the Dean of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Yang Xiaoming, were present at the opening ceremony and gave their addresses. Nearly 1,000 students from the Central School of Nursing attended the event and visited the photo exhibition.

items.title: 明起新一轮冷空气接踵而至 我国大部将迎大风降温
items.summary: 今天（12月14日），全国大部降水仍稀少，雨雪零散分布，冷空气影响也进入尾声阶段。不过，从明天开始，新一轮实力更强的冷空气接踵而至，将率先从新疆北部展开，随后逐渐给我国大部地区带来大风降温天气，同时西南、江汉等地降水也将增多。
items.titleEn: A new round of cold air is expected to bring much of our country to the brink of cooling.
items.summaryEn: Today (December 14), most of the country's rainfall is still scarce, rain and snow are scattered, and the effects of cold air are in the final stages. However, starting tomorrow, a new wave of stronger cold air will be delivered from northern Xinjiang, which will gradually bring cooler weather to much of China, while rainfall will increase in southwest, Jianghan and other areas.
